summary: This bill prohibits the Department of Homeland Security from spending money on biometric surveillance systems or hiring new ICE officers until it submits a report outlining a policy for using such systems that protects constitutional rights and details their costs and compliance with local privacy laws.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts immigration enforcement by limiting funding for surveillance systems and hiring additional ICE officers until a specific report on data use is submitted. It also mandates the deletion of certain collected information and restricts the ability to prevent recording of enforcement operations, all of which aim to constrain ICE's operational capacity and methods, thus pushing towards less aggressive enforcement.
